title: Quasi-coherent perfect internal dual
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let K belong to D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] with K perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. There is a quasi-coherent perfect object D whose underlying derived object equals R\mathcal Hom(K,O_X) [def-pur-derived-internal-hom].

proof.text: Define D to be the actual RHom(K,O_X). At each point unpack the IsPerfect witness and refine its strictly perfect representative to a bounded finite free representative on an affine open.

Compute its finite free dual with the explicit ordinary Hom-complex model. Compose the inverse computation with the first-variable image of the local representative isomorphism and the inverse RHom open restriction isomorphism. This gives bounded finite free local models for the actual D.
Use the hom and inverse of each finite free identification as a retraction. These local models prove IsPerfect X D. Forget the lower bound in the same models to obtain IsPseudoCoherent X D.

Apply quasi-coherence of pseudo-coherent objects. Bundle the actual D with this proof in D_QCoh; its underlying object equals RHom(K,O_X) by reflexivity, and it has the perfection proof just established.
